question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1 i.e. 'an'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"an" **is used before words that start with a vowel sound, which makes it grammatically correct before the word "online".
 
• It fits smoothly into the sentence, maintaining the flow and readability of the passage.
 
• Using **"an" before "online" **adheres to the rules of English grammar, ensuring the sentence is properly structured.

**Therefore, the correct answer is 'Option 1'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The options "in", "a", and "the" do not fit due to grammatical rules regarding indefinite articles before words starting with vowel sounds.
